T: Sometimes dead is better. Fresh is best.
D: A doctor moves his family to rural Maine and learns about the burial ground beyond the pet cemetery.
P: Serve the beers when Louis and Jud sit out on the porch.
S: beers on the porch across the road with Jud
Salted peanuts roasted in the shell, pickled onions and a wedge of sharp cheddar with crackers, laid out on an old tray for the porch.
Muffin batter of flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, fresh blueberries folded in, cinnamon crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the family picnic in the field by the road
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a splash of pickle juice, piped back in, smoked paprika and chives on top.
M: Louis stays home alone while the family visits Chicago
Turkey breast brined overnight, rolled with sage butter, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested, sliced, with stuffing, cranberry sauce and gravy.
Molasses baked beans with ham hock, served with steamed brown bread and coleslaw. Soak 500g navy beans overnight.
W: Apples sliced and tossed with cinnamon, sugar and lemon, covered with a crumble of oats, flour, brown sugar and cold butter, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Pouring cream.
K: Jud's cold beers on the porch
American lager from the fridge in the bottle, cracked open on the porch as the trucks go by.

s.note: beers on the porch across the road with Jud
s.how: Roast 400g peanuts in the shell at 180C for 20 minutes and salt while hot. Lay out on an old tray with pickled onions, a wedge of 200g sharp cheddar and crackers for the porch.

Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 80g melted butter and 1 egg briefly. Fold in 200g blueberries. Spoon into a 12-hole tin, top with cinnamon crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.how: Soak 500g navy beans overnight. Bake with 1 ham hock, 1 onion, 80ml molasses, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp mustard and 1L water at 150C for 4 hours. Serve with buttered brown bread and coleslaw.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.

d.note: Jud's cold beers on the porch
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager. Crack them open on the porch and drink from the bottle, keeping well back from the road as the trucks go by.
